title: Teaching Material Knowledge Index
description: Sprint AI-113 AI-807 (Platform Hardening — Teaching Material Package Standard). A real, auto-generated rollup of this material's own knowledge points — never hand-authored, never a second source of truth: every entry is derived directly from this same Package's summary.json coreConcepts and questions.json per-question knowledgePoint fields (both already real, schema-approved fields since Sprint AI-112). Generated by GenerateTeachingMaterialData.js alongside index.json/TeachingMaterialData.js, not bridged into any Runtime (same 'provisional, no Runtime target' treatment as related.json — see Architecture_TeachingMaterialRepository_Foundation_v1.0.md) — this file exists so the platform's offline tooling can directly recognize what a material actually covers, per AI-807's own '平台可以直接辨識' wording, without crossing the Practice-Mode/Exam-Mode Runtime LOCK boundary (no bridge into AHS.KnowledgeRuntime).
